pages.quiz:
COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. Which statement about Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen.
   D. Treat Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.

4. Which statement about Advocacy in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Advocacy in the Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Advocacy in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Advocacy in the Community as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the Community.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

6. Which statement about Building Resilience is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Building Resilience never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Building Resilience with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Building Resilience as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience.

7. Which statement about Problem Validation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Problem Validation as rumours only.
   B. Say Problem Validation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Validation.
   D. Explain Problem Validation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Implementation and Reflection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation and Reflection.
   B. Say Implementation and Reflection never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Implementation and Reflection as rumours only.
   D. Explain Implementation and Reflection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Support Systems as rumours only.
   B. Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Support Systems.
   D. Say Support Systems never happens in Kenya.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

12. Which statement about Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup.
   C. Say Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Support Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Making Important Choices and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. A — Explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. B — Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. B — Explain Advocacy in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A — Nairobi

6. B — Explain Building Resilience with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. D — Explain Problem Validation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Explain Implementation and Reflection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. B — Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. C — Plan income and spending wisely

11. D — Explain symbols used on a map

12. A — Explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Support Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Making Important Choices; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
